Senior Living Tour Comparison Kit v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a structured framework to compare senior living facilities.
- Helps users organize and evaluate tours based on care levels, costs, staffing, safety, activities, meals, and location.
- Offers guided prompts for assessing both resident needs and detailed facility features.
- Supports note-taking, follow-up questions, and creating a side-by-side comparison matrix for informed decision-making.
- Includes clear disclaimers regarding medical, legal, and financial advice.
